menuCategories.title: Starters
menuCategories.intro: Shareable plates meant for the middle of the table.

items.name: Smoked Hummus
items.description: Chickpeas and tahini finished with charcoal-smoked Syrian olive oil, paprika oil, and hot Arabic bread.

items.name: Beef Kofta Tartare
items.description: Australian Black Angus with harissa, garlic sauce, lemon, walnut, and chives.

items.name: Halloumi Fattoush
items.description: Heirloom tomatoes, kyuri, toasted sourdough croutons, halloumi, olives, spring onion dressing.

menuCategories.title: From the oven
menuCategories.intro: Pide and bread pulled from the brick oven all evening.

items.name: Mariah Pide
items.description: Minced lamb, pomegranate seeds and sauce, tahini, pine nuts.

items.name: Mushroom Pide
items.description: Fresh mushrooms, truffle paste, onion, and a bright finish of lime.

items.name: Arabic Bread
items.description: Puffy, sesame-dusted flatbread, served hot from the oven.

menuCategories.title: Mains
menuCategories.intro: Centrepieces built for sharing, with tang, smoke, and spice.

items.name: Kebab Khashkhash
items.description: Lamb skewers in a sharp poppy seed sauce, sealed under a bread cap.

items.name: Australian Lamb Rack
items.description: Pan-seared lamb on muhammara with pistachios, pickled beetroot, and herbs.

items.name: Wagyu Beef
items.description: Australian BMS2 striploin, eggplant puree, tomato raisins, hazelnuts, 12-spice oil.

items.name: Grilled Chicken
items.description: Brined kampung chicken with garlic sauce, soy reduction, sumac, and local herbs.

items.name: Duck Breast
items.description: Four-day dry-aged duck with batata harra, chimichurri, citrus zest, and greens.

menuCategories.title: Sweets
menuCategories.intro: A soft close after the spice and smoke.

items.name: Kunafa Ice Cream
items.description: Smoked pistachio cream under crackly kataifi, finished with dried apricot.

items.name: Kurma Labneh
items.description: Stuffed dates with strained yogurt, honey, and roasted almond.

signatures.name: Smoked Hummus
signatures.note: The dish that put Leen's on KL maps. Thick, smoky, and scooped with bread still hot from the oven.

signatures.name: Kebab Khashkhash
signatures.note: Lamb under a bread lid. Cut it open and steam carries spice across the table.

signatures.name: Australian Lamb Rack
signatures.note: Sweet-sour muhammara, pistachios, and lamb cooked with Syrian zest in mind.

testimonials.quote: This is the city's most addictive hummus. A thick, smooth blend with charcoal-smoked Syrian olive oil.
testimonials.name: Eat Drink KL

testimonials.quote: Unmistakably Middle Eastern, rife with bold colours and flavours. Try the kebab khashkhash.
testimonials.name: MICHELIN Guide

testimonials.quote: Super cozy and one of the best places for hummus in KL. Reserve ahead.
testimonials.name: Local diner
